title: The Hoodie Knew The Code 🤖 Ep.2
endcard: FINALE: THE NAME ON THE TAG

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 2 A.M. One camera. One hoodie. And a door that was opened… with a KEY. Nobody broke in. Somebody let themselves in.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: You think it's ME?! Bro, I was in ranked matches till 4 a.m.! Forty people watched me lose! FORTY WITNESSES!

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Checked his game log. He's clean. Painfully clean. He lost eleven times.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: …You didn't have to say the number.

lines.speaker: mim
lines.text: Okay, fine — I WAS at school that night. Painting in the art room. Alone. At 2 a.m. Don't judge my process.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Her paint is blue. The dust on the staff-room window sill? White. Chalk. Mim never came near that room.

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: So we're looking for someone with chalk on their shoes… and a key that shouldn't exist. This school has DEPTHS.

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: Children, please. Only three keys open that door. Mine… the principal's… and the office spare.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Then it's simple! Check the spare hook! Key still there — a thief copied it. Key gone—

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: It's gone. The hook is empty. But the name tag is still hanging there.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every eye in that office turned to the little plastic tag. And the name written on it… stopped the whole investigation cold.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Whoever's name this is — you have until morning. After that… I start expelling FIRST and asking questions LATER.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Follow for the finale — because the name on that tag… made NO sense. Nobody saw it coming. NOBODY.
